summary: Correct README and SKILL.md to the real command surface: auth login/logout/status, sync --community, and neutral placeholder slugs.
reason: Both docs instructed `skool-pp-cli auth set-token`, which the shipped binary has never had (the auth surface is login|logout|status). The Quick Start also showed `sync <slug>` as a positional (sync takes --community), `members at-risk` (no such command), and `sync --snapshot-now` (no such flag). Every documented entry point in the changed blocks was checked against `--help` output.
validated_outcome: Each command and flag in the edited blocks verified against `skool-pp-cli --help` / `auth --help` / `posts --help` output from this build. verify_skill.py passes.
